decisions.reason: As a multi-model line with its own dedicated page, the aloe vera facial line carries the most investment and visible commitment, so management would persist and attribute any early weakness to the launch phase.

The hyaluronic serum is close to the core facial range and cheap to keep producing in small batches, and nothing indicates disappointing results, though its low visibility means little would have to be justified if it were dropped.
A cleansing milk is a staple that complements the facial care range and needs little investment to sustain, so with no sign of failure management keeps it despite the limited public commitment.
